items.title: 68189_Al Hall oral history interview
items.q: I saw Erskine Hawkins' band come to the theater, and Stanfield was the bass player.

ctx.x: Yeah, because when I was -- when I was young and first started playing at 17, I saw Erskine Hawkins'
band come to the theater, and Stanfield was the bass player. And he was slapping and straddling and spinning it and whatnot.
Well, you had to do that too, you remember.
